notes.title: Early-Access May 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As announced in the title, the game will finally be released in [b]Early-Access very soon in May 2025[/b]! it should only have the 1st chapter of the adventure, which also serves as a tutorial. I think there will be plenty to do while waiting for the sequel, which will be released quickly in future updates. a Sandbox type map will likely be available. It will be available in several languages.

In future updates, many additions and modifications will be made: gameplay added and/or modified, map additions, graphical improvements, bug fixes, etc.
The game is quite advanced overall, I've been working on it alone for several years, which therefore takes more time and requires acquiring a lot of knowledge in different areas.

A Discord is available - [url=https://discord.gg/jf5MGvgD]click here[/url] - for all types of questions and information, whether on upcoming new features, updates, your suggestions, bug reports, gameplay videos that you would like to share or screenshots, or simply to chat between you on the game.


I sincerely hope you like it, and I will continue to do everything I can to offer you the best gaming experience possible.

Good game everyone!ːsteamhappyː
